recipe.title: Chicken Ranch Quest Chip Lunch Box
recipe.summary: A portable chicken lunch box with cottage-cheese ranch, crunchy cucumbers, grapes, and Quest Nacho Cheese Protein Chips.
recipe.story: Pack it the night before and grab it on the way out. It has the crunchy chips and ranch-dip feeling of a snack lunch, but enough protein to count as an actual meal.
recipe.serving_size: 3 ounces chicken bites | 1 bag Quest Nacho Cheese Protein Chips | 1 cup cucumber slices | 1/2 cup grapes | 1/4 cup cottage-cheese ranch
ingredients: 18 ounces Fresh Additions Fully Cooked Chicken Breast Bites
6 individual bags Quest Nacho Cheese Protein Chips

ingredient_sections.title: Lunch Boxes
items: 18 ounces Fresh Additions Fully Cooked Chicken Breast Bites
6 individual bags Quest Nacho Cheese Protein Chips

instructions: Blend the cottage cheese, milk, and ranch seasoning until completely smooth.
Divide the ranch among 6 small sealed containers, 1/4 cup per serving.
Add 3 ounces chicken, 1 cup cucumber slices, 1/2 cup grapes, and one ranch container to each divided lunch box.
Keep the Quest chips sealed and outside the refrigerated lunch box until ready to eat.
Pack one bag of Quest chips with each cold lunch box before leaving.
freezer_storage: Do not freeze the assembled lunch boxes, cucumbers, grapes, cottage-cheese ranch, or Quest chips.
The cooked chicken may be frozen separately. If four servings remain, use a gallon-size freezer bag. If fewer than four servings remain, use a quart-size freezer bag.
Remove excess air and freeze the chicken for up to 3 months.
reheating_instructions: This meal is designed to be eaten cold.
If preferred, microwave the chicken separately for 45 to 60 seconds until it reaches 165°F, then return it to the lunch box.
tips: Leave the chips in their original sealed bag so they stay crunchy.
Use a frozen lunch-pack insert if the box will be away from a refrigerator.
